decision.explanation: The painting "David with the Head of Goliath" is attributed to multiple artists based on different works. Caravaggio created versions of this subject around 1600 and 1607, while Massimo Stanzione's version is dated to approximately 1642-1643 and is housed in the San Diego Museum of Art.
